lines.text: A watchman blows the ram's horn, and a man who ignores it and is taken by the sword bears his own blood.
If the watchman fails to blow the horn and the sword takes a life, God holds the watchman accountable.
God makes Ezekiel a watchman for the land of Egypt and tells him to give the warning from Him.
Israel says their sins are heavy and asks how to live; God takes no pleasure in the wicked's death.
A wicked man who turns from his sin and fasts for forty days will surely live.
